text_block_list.text:
Having seized 1st place in the exhibition 
race, Special Week headed over to observe 
the Winning Live—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, congratulations on 1st place. It 
was a truly eye-catching race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pheeeww...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Suzuka-san! I'm so sorry, I just 
suddenly got really nervous!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see, the live concert... In that case, 
let me tell you a little secret.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...?

Silence Suzuka gently took Special Week's 
hand and whispered softly into her ear.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When you step onto that stage... Take a 
close look at the face of each and every 
person in the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Each and every person...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Now, go claim your podium. ...Have fun out 
there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, there are so many people...! 
Performing in front of such a huge 
crowd...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The music...! I have to get out on stage 
now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh... my legs... won't move. Why?! 
Please, move...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What should I do... Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Take a close look at the face of each and 
every person in the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Each and every person...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Speeee!! That was the best run ever!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, we love youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I can hear them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The people here... watched my run. They're 
the ones cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... I'm so happy. How can 
I convey my gratitude to them?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Please! Just give me a little bit of 
courage!

Special Week dashed onto the stage and 
began dancing with all her heart!

And though clumsy at times, she pulled off 
every step packed with pure emotion.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan!! Thank you sooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is all mine, ...

However, Special Week tripped over her own 
foot and tumbled right onto the stage!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That clumsy charm is what makes you Spe!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... !!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan! Let's keep running together 
forever and ever~!!

Special Week's live performance concluded 
amidst a thunderous roar of cheers.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All the fans looked so happy. ...I think 
you put on a wonderful stage.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, I think I finally understand, 
desu...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A live performance is a place where you 
convey your heartfelt gratitude, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I used to think I only wanted to become 
the number one in Japan for Mommy's sake, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I will carry all the heartfelt wishes of 
everyone cheering for me and become the 
number one horse girl in Japan, 
ganbarimasu!!
